blocker.reason: The provider stores no preview thread or generation, status only checks whether _preview_httpd exists, and start may kill an unrelated process occupying the port. UIAudit cannot safely repair this from outside the provider process.

requiredAtomicSemantics: Reject unless expectedControlPid equals os.getpid(), expectedPreviewPid equals the provider-owned preview PID and expectedGeneration equals the current generation.
Reject if the configured port is owned by a different PID before recovery.
Stop only the provider-owned HTTPServer object; call shutdown, server_close and join the recorded thread with a bound timeout.
Bind the replacement HTTPServer directly while holding the process-local lifecycle lock; if bind reports address-in-use, return conflict and never kill the occupant.
Increment generation only after a successful bind and thread start.
Run an internal bounded HTTP readiness probe before returning running=true.
The normal /api/preview/start path must use the same bind-without-kill primitive; _kill_port_occupants must not be called by start or recover.
forbidden: returning running=true from _preview_httpd is not None alone
